queries_run: Scientific & Technical Instruments alternative technology disruption 2026 2027

findings.claim: FTV 10-K 風險因子稱其產業技術變化快、新品頻繁推出；若不能及時推出創新產品，現有產品會隨時間過時，競爭地位與財務將受損。未點名任何具體替代技術。
findings.excerpt: We generally sell our products and services in industries that are characterized by rapid technological changes, frequent new product introductions and changing industry standards. If we do not develop innovative new and enhanced products and services on a timely basis, our offerings will become obsolete over time and our competitive position and financial results will suffer.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋未找到點名具體替代技術的來源；2026 10-Q 與產業搜尋皆僅有泛稱風險語言與市場報告。
